name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.constantAt_mem_locLetterPart
summary: 1 ⊗ c lies in the Frobenius-shifted Kisin module of the trivial lattice and its values are fixed, hence in 𝒦_0; the letter projection lands in locLetterPart.

steps.claim: By letterProj_mem_of_valueFieldPoints it suffices that 1 ⊗ c ∈ valueFieldPoints(frobKisinAinf(trivLattice(S), l)): it is in the A_inf-lattice, all its Frobenius values are integral (C has the trivial action), and for an invariant form μ, μ(1 ⊗ c) is fixed by Γ', hence in 𝒦_0 (mem_valueField_of_fixed).
steps.lean:
letterProj_mem_of_valueFieldPoints (by
  simpa [valueFieldPoints, frobKisinAinf, kisinAinf, le_saturateBy (mk_one_mem_ainfLattice _),
    forall_and] using fun _ m ↦ mem_valueField_of_fixed (m c))
